items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: then a few weeks later, made another with Clark Terry, Count Basie, Lockjaw Davis

ctx.x: Then after that, he asked me if I would make, you know, some albums for him. And I made one, I believe, in February of '76 and a few weeks later, I made one with ... Dizzy Gillespie and I and the rhythm section, and then a few weeks later, made another with Clark Terry, Count Basie, Lockjaw Davis ... oh, who else was on that one; I think Louie Bellson. But that's about 3 in about 3 months, and now I'm scheduled to make another one on the 23rd of this month, which is just about 10 days away.
So you suddenly have a new rush of album activity?
